name: Video Super Resolution (prototype)
author: Echo-Storm
description: A prototype. Off until you switch it on. Upscales with NVIDIA's RTX Video Super Resolution in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler: a trained network that sharpens the picture one frame at a time, which suits still scenes, menus, interface text and video. It uses the files of NVIDIA's Video Effects SDK in its vfx folder (with NVIDIA's licences), or your own copy of the SDK (setting vfxDir). Choose NIS as the Scaling Type and run the game in a window smaller than the screen. Only one upscaler works at a time.
